name: Berserk Butcher
game_text:
<keyword>Damage +1</keyword>. Berserk Butcher is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish.
<phase>Maneuver</phase>: Remove an <culture>Isengard</culture> token from a machine and exert Berserk Butcher twice to prevent all wounds to Uruk-hai until the assignment phase.
